command.name: amend-account
options: --attestation-custodian <file-pkcs8> --attestation-principal-id <uuid> --attestation-key-file <path> --attestation-passphrase-file <path> (repeat one through 64 aligned credential triplets under the selected custody)
command.summary: Replace the definition of a never-posted, unreferenced account without erasing its identity or lifecycle history.
